nodes.description: Immutable constant uint256 PERIOD = 30 minutes used as the minimum elapsed window between oracle updates.
Immutable address of the ICCFactory used to resolve pairs, sort tokens and query pairFor.
Private mapping(address => Observation) storing cumulative prices, timestamp and average prices per pair.
Block timestamp, miner-influenced, used to compute timeElapsed and counterfactual cumulative prices.
Constructor that sets the immutable factory address and rejects the zero address.
External view returning the stored observation fields for a token pair.
Public function that initialises or refreshes the observation of a pair, computing time-weighted average prices.
External function resolving a pair from two tokens and delegating to updatePair.
External view returning the amount out using the stored average price of the pair.
Internal view returning block.timestamp truncated to uint32.
Internal view producing counterfactual cumulative prices for a pair using reserves and elapsed time.
Unchecked uint32 subtraction timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - observation.blockTimestampLast where wrap-around is intended but affects the PERIOD gate.
Unchecked accumulation priceCumulative += uint(fraction(reserve)._x) * timeElapsed with deliberate overflow.
Division (priceCumulative - lastCumulative) / timeElapsed producing the uq112x112 average price.
Fixed-point multiplication of the stored average price by amountIn followed by decode144 in consult.
Constructor parameter address _factory used to initialise the immutable factory state variable.
First token address parameter of getObservation.
Second token address parameter of getObservation.
Pair address parameter of updatePair that is used to index pairObservations.
First token address parameter of update.
Second token address parameter of update.
Input token address parameter of consult.
Input amount parameter of consult multiplied by the average price.
Output token address parameter of consult.
Pair address parameter of currentCumulativePrices, cast to ICCPair for reserve and cumulative reads.
Local address pair resolved via factory.getPair in getObservation.
Local storage pointer observation referencing pairObservations[pair] in updatePair.
Local uint32 timeElapsed computed from the current and previous block timestamps in updatePair.
Local address pair resolved via factory.getPair in update.
Local address pair resolved via factory.pairFor in consult.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is read inside currentBlockTimestamp and truncated to uint32, making the timestamp value miner-influenced.
currentCumulativePrices invokes currentBlockTimestamp to derive the blockTimestamp used for counterfactual pricing.
The unchecked cumulative price multiplication and addition is executed inside currentCumulativePrices.
The block timestamp indirectly determines the counterfactual cumulative price accumulation computed in currentCumulativePrices.
updatePair computes timeElapsed by unchecked uint32 subtraction of the stored observation timestamp.
timeElapsed is derived from block.timestamp via currentCumulativePrices, so it depends on the timestamp.
updatePair divides the cumulative price deltas by timeElapsed to derive the average prices.
consult performs the fixed-point multiplication of the stored average price by amountIn and decodes it.
The constant PERIOD is read in updatePair to require a minimum elapsed window before updating.
The immutable factory address is used to resolve the pair in getObservation.
The immutable factory address is used to resolve tokenA/tokenB into a pair in update.
The immutable factory address is used for pairFor and sortTokens in consult.
getObservation reads its returned values from the pairObservations mapping.
updatePair reads and writes the Observation stored in pairObservations for the given pair.
consult reads the stored average prices from pairObservations.
update delegates the whole update logic to updatePair and returns its boolean result.

In the initialisation branch of updatePair the external calls to ICCPair (price0CumulativeLast, price1CumulativeLast, getReserves) happen before the pairObservations state writes, so a malicious pair contract can re-enter updatePair.
Constructor parameter _factory is validated and assigned to the immutable factory state variable.
Parameter tokenA is forwarded to factory.getPair in getObservation.
Parameter tokenB is forwarded to factory.getPair in getObservation.
Parameter pair indexes pairObservations and is cast to ICCPair in updatePair.
Parameter tokenA is passed to factory.getPair in update.
Parameter tokenB is passed to factory.getPair in update.
Parameter tokenIn selects the pair and the price side in consult.
Parameter amountIn is multiplied by the stored average price in consult.
Parameter tokenOut is used with tokenIn for pairFor and sortTokens in consult.
Parameter pair of currentCumulativePrices is used for all ICCPair external calls.
Local pair resolved in getObservation is used to index pairObservations.
Local storage pointer observation holds the Observation being initialised or refreshed in updatePair.
Local timeElapsed gates the PERIOD requirement and divides the cumulative price deltas in updatePair.
Local pair resolved in update is forwarded to updatePair.
Local pair resolved in consult is used to load the observation and average prices.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _factory only feeds the Oracle constructor and is subsumed by that core function node.
Parameter tokenA is only used by getObservation to resolve the pair, so it merges into the function node.
Parameter tokenB is only used by getObservation to resolve the pair, so it merges into the function node.
Parameter pair exists only to index the observation inside updatePair.
Parameter tokenA is only consumed by the factory.getPair call in update.
Parameter tokenB is only consumed by the factory.getPair call in update.
Parameter tokenIn only selects the pair and price side inside consult.
Parameter amountIn is the multiplicand of the unsafe fixed-point multiplication executed in consult.
Parameter tokenOut is only used with tokenIn for pairFor and sortTokens inside consult.
Parameter pair of the library helper is only used for the ICCPair reads inside currentCumulativePrices.
Local pair is the intermediate result of getObservation and merges into that function node.
Local storage pointer observation belongs to the updatePair state mutation logic.
Local timeElapsed is the result of the unsafe unchecked subtraction in updatePair.
Local pair of update is a transient result merged into the update function node.
Local pair of consult is a transient lookup result merged into the consult function node.
